messages:
maria: Quick pulse — Q3 milestone check. Please drop a one-line status for each milestone you own (shipped / slipped / blocked) + ETA + any blocking deps. I’ll compile for the Fri sync. @alex @anita @tim
alex: M1 (realtime batching): canary shipped yesterday. Perf looks good: p50 -18%, p90 -12%. Need one final perf run before full rollout. ETA full rollout: EOW (Fri). PRs: #3421, #3430. Noting some retry spikes in 2 GCP zones, @tim fyi.
tim: I see the retry spike. Rolling a small autoscaler config fix now (scale-down threshold). Will watch metrics; not blocking.
anita: M2 (model v2 rollout): slipping. Internal evals found a quality regression on synth prompts — looks like a tokenization mismatch from the conversion script. Owner: @alex + @kevin. New ETA: next Tue. Plan: revert conversion commit, add unit + eval tests, rerun harness.
kevin: I reproduced the mismatch locally. Added a quick unit to capture the tokenization diff and an eval alert in Optimize. Working on patch; will open PR today.
alex: Revert/patch is fine, but need product signoff on acceptable metric delta before we re-roll. @maria can you confirm thresholds for this rollout?
maria: For this rollout we allow up to 1.5% ROUGE drop and <=0.05 LLR drop. Anything beyond that requires rollback.
kevin: Ack — will target <1%.
anita: M3 (cost-savings pilot): partial ship — quant pipeline is live in Dedicated but Private deployment is blocked pending security review for HSM access changes. Blocker: security review.
security-bot: security-review ticket created: SR-788. Reviewer assigned: oliver. Estimated ETA: 3 business days.
maria: Great, thanks. Summary for the sync: M1 on track for full rollout by Fri, M2 slipped (tokenization fix + eval) to Tue, M3 partial ship + security review blocking Private. Action items: @alex revert+patch for M2, @kevin tests+alert, @tim monitor autoscaler fix, @anita coordinate with security. I’ll update the board and the sync doc.
anita: Quick ask — can eng owners add a one-sentence 'next risk' line to their milestone card? Helps the PMs triage.
alex: Done for M1 and M2 cards.
kevin: Added next-risk line for M2.
maria: Thanks all — if anything changes, ping here. :thumbsup:
